map.从混合文本中筛出英文字母与单词，剔除中文与符号，便于提取代码标识符、外文术语或做: Filters English letters and words out of mixed text while dropping Chinese characters and symbols, making it easy to pull out code identifiers and foreign terms or analyze English strings. Fully local processing that protects your privacy.
map.从双语文本抽英文：保留拉丁字母词，便于英文校对或术语提取。: Extract English from bilingual text: keep Latin-script words for English proofreading or term extraction.
map.清理中文干扰：得到纯英文片段做拼写/语法检查。: Remove Chinese interference: get pure English fragments for spell and grammar checks.
map.术语表准备：抽英文术语与中文对照分离。: Glossary preparation: separate English terms from their Chinese counterparts.
map.：输入「API 接口已就绪，deploy 完成」，提取英文输出「API depl: : enter "API ready, deploy done" and the English extraction yields "API deploy done" with the Chinese filtered out; useful for tabulating terms on their own.
map.默认只抽连续拉丁字母词，数字与连字符视设置；「API-1」是否整体抽出可在选项里: By default only runs of Latin letters are extracted, with digits and hyphens depending on the setting; whether "API-1" comes out whole is configurable in the options.
map.和提取中文互补吗？: Does It Complement the Chinese Extractor?
map.是。两工具分别抽中英，合起来可拆分双语内容做对照翻译或术语库。: Yes. The two tools extract Chinese and English respectively, and together they can split bilingual content for side-by-side translation or a term base.
